title: 2-CTA MMA: a tcgen05 GEMM with clusters and paired CTAs

steps.title: cluster and pair MMA: two CTAs compute one 256×256 tile together
persistent pair: accumulator double buffering and cross-CTA release

cases.name: one_tile
cases.purpose: Exactly one pair tile and one K tile: which block of C the leader's A/B halves and the peer's halves each cover, M = 256 in idesc, B split in half along N; one mistake and the result is not exactly equal.

cases.name: leader_only
cases.purpose: The peer's halves of A and B are entirely out of bounds: the peer's TMA must still complete_tx the whole box on the leader's full barrier (all zeros), and the peer's epilogue write-back is clipped entirely.

cases.name: long_k
cases.purpose: A single tile, 16 K tiles: the 6-stage ring buffer wraps around almost 3 times; the producers of the two CTAs each wait on their own empty (multicast commit), and all completions go to the leader's full.

cases.name: short_k
cases.purpose: 3 K tiles, fewer than the pipeline stages: the drain before exit waits only for commits that really happened, and the first-round parity waits must pass immediately.

cases.name: aligned
cases.purpose: 2 × 4 pair tiles, fewer than the number of resident clusters: one tile per cluster.

cases.name: tail
cases.purpose: Neither M nor N is a multiple of 256: in the second row of tiles the leader has only 133 valid rows and the peer is entirely out of bounds; the last column of tiles has only 44 columns, and the peer's half of B is entirely out of bounds.

cases.name: raster
cases.purpose: 6 × 3 pair tiles (the last row of tiles has 20 rows, the last column 88 columns), a K tail of 8 columns.

cases.name: persistent
cases.purpose: 13 × 12 = 156 pair tiles, more than the number of resident clusters (74): some clusters process 3 tiles, rotating accumulators 0, 1, 0, and acc_empty receives 256 arrivals from the two CTAs; 6 K tiles per tile, so the ring buffer position carries over across tiles; the last row of tiles has only 228 rows (the peer has only 100 valid rows); the last group of grouped rasterization with G = 8 has only 5 rows. Step 3 takes cluster 4 (78 tiles of 256×512, 3 rounds).

cases.name: random
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data: error of the same order as cuBLAS.

cases.name: square
cases.purpose: Tensor Core throughput: 137 GFLOP, 256 tiles of 256×256, directly comparable with lab 32.

cases.name: wide
cases.purpose: 550 GFLOP, 128 MB of A and B together (more than L2): the pair tile lowers each CTA's L2 reads from 48 KB per K tile to 32 KB per K tile.

cases.name: flat
cases.purpose: 137 GFLOP but only 16 K tiles per tile: writing the 256 MB of C is of the same order as the main loop, so the epilogue must overlap the main loop.
